title: NodeEnrollmentPossessionDelta
$comment: PROPOSAL ONLY. Not merged into OpenAPI or node-enrollment.schema.json. NodeEnrollment is closed and has no proof-of-possession or key-scheme field. Do not activate POST /v1/nodes/enrollments until this delta is reviewed and the route is explicitly registered.

publicKeyScheme.description: Node crypto Ed25519 raw 32-byte public key. Not an Ethereum address or wallet signature.

signature.description: Ed25519 signature over the canonical possession message. 64 raw bytes, lowercase hex.
